advisories.summary: --history=archive no longer keeps data columns past the 18-day retention window. High urgency on Sepolia for the Glamsterdam fork; medium urgency elsewhere.
advisories.action: Pass --history=column-archive if you need columns older than 18 days. Sepolia operators should upgrade before Oct 6, 2026.

advisories.summary: Validator-client-only change from v26.9.0. It ignores stale PAYLOAD_DUE_BPS values so mixed beacon nodes stop logging incompatible time configuration. The beacon node matches v26.9.0.
advisories.action: Upgrade the validator client if you see that warning. Sepolia still needs v26.9.0 or v26.9.1 before Oct 6, 2026.
